items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: except he had sterling drummers: George Wettling and Cliff Leeman

ctx.x: Was the Condon band, perhaps, had some swing influence to it?

Well yeah I would think so. And I think primarily the swing influence was Eddie Condon himself. He played a wonderful four-string plectrum guitar that was specially made for him by Gibson, but this was after he had already learned banjo and gravitated toward a plectrum guitar. But it was that swinging guitar that really propelled the band, I think, except he had sterling drummers: George Wettling and Cliff Leeman, and people like that. So yeah I think that was the aspect to it that really got to me. We felt it…
Okay. You felt which was more two-beat?
